name: karpathy-loop
description: Autonomous Loop Engineering engine generalized from Andrej Karpathy's Autoresearch method. Enables AI agents to run iterative hypothesis-modify-execute-validate-improve cycles for continuous optimization of any measurable software engineering metric — performance, build time, bundle size, test coverage, correctness — not limited to ML training.

memory_caching.description: Splits stable experiment context (program.md, metric definitions, baseline results) from per-iteration dynamic state, combined with prompt caching via OpenAI/Anthropic APIs to avoid recomputing shared system prompts across loop iterations. Reduces token cost as the number of iterations grows.

endpoints.name: /runLoop
endpoints.description: Start an autonomous loop that iteratively optimizes target code against a defined metric. Agent reads program.md, modifies target file, runs experiment, evaluates metric, and commits/reverts.

input.target_file: string (path to code file to optimize, e.g. src/parser.ts)
input.evaluation_script: string, optional (path to setup script or eval harness; omit when the target's own test/build/bench command already emits metric_name directly — program.md must then name that command explicitly)

endpoints.name: /getResults
endpoints.description: Retrieve current or historical results from a loop run, including iteration log, best metric, and improvement history.

endpoints.name: /runExperiment
endpoints.description: Execute a single isolated experiment iteration (dry-run or validation). Returns full metric output without commit/rollback.

input.evaluation_script: string, optional (see /runLoop — omit only when program.md names a self-contained target command)

endpoints.name: /getCacheStatus
endpoints.description: Inspect current cache state — prompt cache hits and cold-storage size per cache layer.

endpoints.name: /revertLast
endpoints.description: Revert the last accepted change in a loop run. Useful when a metric improvement is later found to be spurious.

testing_steps.name: Manifest Audit
testing_steps.expected: All permissions listed (llm_api_access, file_storage_read_write, network_access, git_operations) must be requested at init.

testing_steps.name: Baseline /runExperiment
testing_steps.description: Create a mock eval script that prints p95_latency_ms: 150 after 2s sleep. Hit /runExperiment and verify metric extraction.

testing_steps.name: Autonomous /runLoop
testing_steps.description: Write a minimal program.md asking the agent to reduce p95_latency_ms. Start /runLoop with max_iterations: 3. Verify agent modifies the target file, experiment runs, metric is evaluated, commit/rollback fires.

testing_steps.name: Cache Layer Test
testing_steps.description: Run /getCacheStatus before and after a loop. Verify prompt cache hits increase across iterations with identical system prefixes.

testing_steps.name: Results & Revert
testing_steps.description: Call /getResults during loop — ensure iterations increment and best_metric tracks. Then call /revertLast and verify git revert.
